stories.title: Bundesliga: Freiburg stürzt Gladbach ganz tief in die Krise

en.title: Bundesliga: Freiburg plunges Gladbach deeper into crisis
en.summary: SC Freiburg defeated Borussia Mönchengladbach decisively at home, intensifying the club's crisis and increasing scrutiny of coach Eugen Polanski. Freiburg moved to the top of the league standings with the victory.

stories.title: Fußball-Bundesliga: Borussia Dortmund glänzt, Gladbach geht in Freiburg unter

en.title: Bundesliga football: Borussia Dortmund shines, Gladbach collapses in Freiburg
en.summary: Borussia Dortmund won convincingly at home while Borussia Mönchengladbach suffered a heavy defeat to SC Freiburg. Freiburg's 5:0 victory moved them to the top of the league.

stories.title: Bundesliga, 3. Spieltag – Samstag: BVB schlägt Paderborn, Freiburg feiert Kantersieg gegen Gladbach

en.title: Bundesliga, matchday 3 – Saturday: BVB beats Paderborn, Freiburg celebrates rout against Gladbach
en.summary: Borussia Dortmund won comfortably at home against Paderborn. Borussia Mönchengladbach lost to SC Freiburg while playing with reduced numbers.

stories.title: 5:0 gegen Gladbach: SC Freiburg schießt sich an die Spitze

en.title: 5:0 against Gladbach: SC Freiburg shoots to the top
en.summary: Gladbach's captain Kleindienst received a red card following strong words. Borussia Mönchengladbach was heavily defeated by SC Freiburg and fell to the bottom of the standings.

stories.title: Kriminalität am Freitagabend: Schüsse auf Linienbus in Hamburg

en.title: Crime on Friday evening: Shots fired at bus in Hamburg
en.summary: Shots were fired at a public transport bus in Hamburg on Friday evening.

stories.title: Demo gegen Rechts: 1.500 Menschen demonstrieren gegen Rechts in Saarbrücken

en.title: Demo against right-wing extremism: 1,500 people demonstrate against right-wing extremism in Saarbrücken
en.summary: Approximately 1,500 people participated in a demonstration against right-wing extremism in Saarbrücken.

en.title: Hamburg-Neugraben: Shots fired at bus
en.summary: A public transport bus was shot at in Hamburg on Friday evening after a teenage girl sought shelter inside following a dispute.

stories.title: Protest in vielen Städten: Zehntausende demonstrieren gegen rechts

en.title: Protest in many cities: Tens of thousands demonstrate against right-wing extremism
en.summary: Tens of thousands of people across Germany participated in demonstrations in over 35 cities opposing right-wing extremism and supporting democracy. Participants called for examination of a ban on the AfD party.

stories.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev trifft im Finale auf Aufschlagriese Ben Shelton

en.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev faces serve giant Ben Shelton in final
en.summary: German tennis player Alexander Zverev has reached the US Open final, where he will face 23-year-old American Ben Shelton, who has delivered surprising performances throughout the tournament.

stories.title: US Open: Alexander Zverevs langer Aufschlag irritiert Gegner Chatschanow

en.title: US Open: Alexander Zverev's long serve irritates opponent Khachanov
en.summary: Alexander Zverev, feared for his powerful serves at the US Open, employs a technique of bouncing the ball frequently before serving, which his semifinal opponent Khachanov found bothersome.

stories.title: Zverev will im US-Open-Finale amerikanischen Traum verhindern

en.title: Zverev aims to prevent American dream in US Open final
en.summary: Alexander Zverev defeated Karen Khachanov to reach the US Open final, where he will face an American opponent.

stories.title: US Open im Tennis: Zverev erreicht Finale und kann wieder Grand-Slam-Sieger werden

en.title: US Open tennis: Zverev reaches final and can become Grand Slam champion again
en.summary: French Open champion Alexander Zverev defeated Russian Khachanov to advance to the US Open final, where he will face American fan favorite Ben Shelton for another major title.

stories.title: Deep Read: Das Gewicht fällt, Verlangen verschwinden – und ein Leben ohne Abnehmpille wird unvorstellbar

en.title: Deep Read: Weight drops, cravings vanish – and life without weight-loss medication becomes unimaginable
en.summary: Weight-loss medications can help people reduce weight, but discontinuing them while maintaining weight loss is difficult. Research indicates these drugs affect the brain, raising questions about potential addiction.

stories.title: Naher Osten: Nach Angriff auf Pipeline: Saudi-Arabien schließt wichtige Alternative zur Straße von Hormus

en.title: Middle East: Following pipeline attack, Saudi Arabia closes important alternative to Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Rising Middle East tensions are restricting oil transport routes, with attacks now targeting a key alternative to the largely closed Strait of Hormuz.

en.title: The world in images: Eye-catcher
en.summary: Photographs capture various human experiences and moments, ranging from impressive and moving to fascinating and disturbing, documenting significant events and small wonders while telling stories about our world.

stories.title: Genossenschaftsbank: Eigner der Raiffeisenbank Plankstetten streichen „genossenschaftlich“

en.title: Cooperative Bank: Owners of Raiffeisenbank Plankstetten Eliminate "Cooperative" Status
en.summary: Shareholders of Raiffeisenbank Plankstetten have voted to abolish the cooperative principle that governed the bank. The shareholder meeting results indicate ongoing disputes about the institution's future direction.

stories.title: Nicolai Tangen: Chef des norwegischen Staatsfonds: „Härtere Zeiten werden kommen, das ist sicher“

en.title: Nicolai Tangen: Chief of Norwegian Sovereign Wealth Fund: "Harder Times Will Come, That Is Certain"
en.summary: The head of Norway's sovereign wealth fund, which manages approximately 2.3 trillion dollars, discusses his expectations for challenging economic periods ahead and insights Norway's experience offers other nations.
